remarks: Welcome to 324 Strawberry Hill Avenue, a charming and well-located 1-bedroom end unit that offers the perfect balance of city convenience and a peaceful retreat. Ideally situated just moments from Westport Ave, you'll have easy access to shopping, dining, and all the major stores and amenities Norwalk has to offer. Despite its central location, the building is quietly tucked away, surrounded by newer high-end residences. Next door, you'll find a green space and dog park that provide a true oasis-like setting right at your doorstep. This home features an assigned garage parking space underneath the building for added ease and security, along with a separate storage area for extra convenience. Heat, hot and cold water are included in the common charges, giving you comfort and peace of mind. The building is also being refreshed with new hallway carpeting and interior paint, ensuring a bright and welcoming feel. Whether you're a first-time buyer, looking to downsize, or seeking an investment property, this unit checks all the boxes. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy a highly desirable location with both modern conveniences and a touch of nature just steps away.
